<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Purpose

This PR adds an opt-in ROCm/AITER FP8 attention path for the Qwen3.8 model family. The path prepares Q/K/V in FP8 and consumes the prequantized tensors directly in prefill and chunked-prefill attention.

The feature remains disabled by default and is enabled with:

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_PREQUANTIZED_QKV=1
```

Once enabled, the ROCm AITER backend uses the prequantized FP8 Q/K/V for causal attention within the current prefill chunk. For chunked-prefill requests that already have cached tokens, the current chunk's queries also attend over the gathered K/V cache in FP8 when the hardware, attention shape, and KV-cache configuration support it.

Today, Q/K normalization, partial RoPE, and gate extraction produce BF16 attention inputs. Chunked prefill then runs two attention calls: causal self-attention within the current chunk, followed by non-causal attention from the current chunk's queries to previously cached K/V. The second call gathers the cached K/V into a BF16 workspace, and both calls consume BF16 inputs.

The new gfx950 path fuses Q/K normalization, RoPE, gate extraction, and FP8 quantization. The causal current-chunk call consumes the resulting FP8 Q/K/V directly. For the second call, an FP8 KV cache remains FP8 while it is gathered, while a BF16 KV cache is quantized as it is gathered into the FP8 workspace. `merge_attn_states` combines the two attention results.

The implementation:

- adds a backend-neutral `PrequantizedQKV` attention input contract;
- adds ROCm AITER support for prequantized Q/K/V and their descales;
- wires the Qwen3.8 model family to fused Q/K norm, RoPE, gate extraction, and FP8 preparation;
- forwards `max_num_seqs` through the Qwen3.8 model wrapper so the preparation workspace is sized correctly;
- keeps pure decode on the existing paged-attention path;
- supports both FP8 and BF16 persistent KV caches;
- automatically uses FP8 for the current chunk's queries attending over gathered cached K/V when supported.

AITER dependency:

- ROCm/aiter#5002
- Target: gfx950

## Test Plan

Focused tests:

```bash
python -m pytest -q \
  tests/model_executor/layers/test_attention_prequantized_qkv.py \
  tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant.py \
  tests/model_executor/layers/test_rocm_aiter_prequantized_qkv.py \
  tests/model_executor/test_qwen3_5_quantization.py
```

Common end-to-end configuration:

- Model: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B MoE MXFP4
- Hardware: 8 × MI355X
- Tensor parallelism: TP8
- Attention backend: `ROCM_AITER_FA`
- `max_num_batched_tokens`: 8192
- Prefix caching: disabled

Production A/B:

| Arm | Configuration |
|---|---|
| A | Existing BF16 attention path with `VLLM_ROCM_USE_PREQUANTIZED_QKV=0` |
| B | FP8 attention with `VLLM_ROCM_USE_PREQUANTIZED_QKV=1`; cached K/V is gathered into the FP8 workspace automatically |

Server command:

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_PREQUANTIZED_QKV=<0-or-1> \
vllm serve MODEL \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA \
  --kv-cache-dtype <auto-or-fp8> \
  --max-model-len 131072 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --compilation-config \
    '{"pass_config":{"enable_qk_norm_rope_fusion":true}}'
```

Performance workloads:

- 1K input / 1K output at concurrency 16
- 8K input / 1K output at concurrency 8
- 60K input / 600 output at concurrency 1, 4, and 8
- 128K input / 1K output at concurrency 1 and 4

GPQA Diamond:

```bash
evalscope eval \
  --model qwen38-2p4t-fp8attn \
  --api-url http://127.0.0.1:18321/v1/chat/completions \
  --api-key EMPTY \
  --eval-type openai_api \
  --datasets gpqa_diamond \
  --eval-batch-size 4 \
  --generation-config \
    '{"max_tokens":100000,"temperature":1.0,"top_p":0.95,"seed":42,"timeout":7200}' \
  --timeout 7200
```

Profile validation:

- capture TP8 traces for 60K/600 c4;
- confirm FP8 causal-group FMHA for attention within the current chunk;
- confirm FP8 group FMHA for the current chunk's queries attending over previously cached K/V;
- confirm `merge_attn_states` combines both partial results;
- verify the BF16 FMHA over gathered cached K/V is absent from the FP8 arm.

## Test Result

Focused validation:

```text
vLLM focused suite: 35 passed
vLLM pre-commit hooks: passed
AITER focused gfx950 suite: 20 passed
Ruff check and format: passed
git diff --check: passed
```

Output-throughput results:

| Workload | Concurrency | Baseline | FP8 attention | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1K input / 1K output | 16 | 829.34 tok/s | 829.02 tok/s | Flat |
| 8K input / 1K output | 8 | 431.49 tok/s | 433.04–434.03 tok/s | Flat |
| 60K input / 600 output | 1 | 59.78 tok/s | 62.29 tok/s | +4.2% |
| 60K input / 600 output | 4 | 109.72 tok/s | 121.95 tok/s | +11.1% |
| 60K input / 600 output | 8 | 130.62 tok/s | 143.13 tok/s | +9.6% |
| 128K input / 1K output | 1 | 50.10 tok/s | 55.76 tok/s | +11.3% |
| 128K input / 1K output | 4 | 84.38 tok/s | 100.76 tok/s | +19.4% |

128K/1K latency:

- c1 mean TTFT: 9.30 s → 7.17 s (-23.0%)
- c4 mean TTFT: 19.07 s → 15.43 s (-19.1%)
- c4 mean TPOT: 28.74 ms → 24.59 ms (-14.4%)

GSM8K with FP8 KV cache:

| Arm | Score |
|---|---:|
| Baseline | 97.42% |
| FP8 attention | 97.50% |

GPQA Diamond with FP8 KV cache:

| Configuration | Correct | Score |
|---|---:|---:|
| Baseline | 184/198 | 92.93% |
| FP8 attention | 183/198 | 92.42% |

Matched GPQA Diamond with BF16 KV cache:

| Arm | Correct | Score |
|---|---:|---:|
| Baseline BF16 attention | 184/198 | 92.93% |
| FP8 attention | 183/198 | 92.42% |


Profile validation completed for FP8 and BF16 KV-cache configurations. The FP8 arm dispatches `fmha_fwd_hd256_fp8_causal_group_gfx950` for causal self-attention within the current chunk and `fmha_fwd_hd256_fp8_group_gfx950` for the current chunk's queries attending over previously cached K/V.

The implementation is performance-neutral at short context and improves long-context output throughput by approximately 10–20% in the measured 60K and 128K workloads.

+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import attention as attention_module
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import PrequantizedQKV
+
+
+def _make_tensors():
+    query = torch.randn(2, 4, 8)
+    key = torch.randn(2, 1, 8)
+    value = torch.randn(2, 1, 8)
+    query_descale = torch.randn(2, 1)
+    key_descale = torch.randn(2, 1)
+    value_descale = torch.randn(2, 1)
+    return (
+        query,
+        key,
+        value,
+        query_descale,
+        key_descale,
+        value_descale,
+    )
+
+
+def test_make_prequantized_qkv_requires_all_tensors():
+    assert (
+        attention_module._make_prequantized_qkv(None, None, None, None, None, None)
+        is None
+    )
+
+    tensors = _make_tensors()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="requires query, key, value"):
+        attention_module._make_prequantized_qkv(
+            tensors[0],
+            tensors[1],
+            tensors[2],
+            tensors[3],
+            tensors[4],
+            None,
+        )
+
+
+def test_make_prequantized_qkv_preserves_tensor_identity():
+    tensors = _make_tensors()
+    result = attention_module._make_prequantized_qkv(*tensors)
+
+    assert isinstance(result, PrequantizedQKV)
+    assert result is not None
+    assert all(actual is expected for actual, expected in zip(result, tensors))
+
+
+class _RecordingAttentionImpl:
+    def __init__(self, supports_prequantized_qkv_input: bool):
+        self.supports_prequantized_qkv_input = supports_prequantized_qkv_input
+        self.standard_calls = 0
+        self.prequantized_calls = 0
+        self.received_prequantized_qkv: PrequantizedQKV | None = None
+
+    def forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        self.standard_calls += 1
+
+    def forward_with_prequantized_qkv(
+        self, *args, prequantized_qkv: PrequantizedQKV, **kwargs
+    ):
+        self.prequantized_calls += 1
+        self.received_prequantized_qkv = prequantized_qkv
+
+
+def _patch_attention_context(monkeypatch, impl):
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(impl=impl)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        attention_module,
+        "get_attention_context",
+        lambda layer_name: (object(), layer, torch.empty(0), None),
+    )
+
+
+def test_unified_attention_dispatches_prequantized_qkv(monkeypatch):
+    impl = _RecordingAttentionImpl(supports_prequantized_qkv_input=True)
+    _patch_attention_context(monkeypatch, impl)
+    tensors = _make_tensors()
+
+    attention_module.unified_attention_with_output(
+        tensors[0],
+        tensors[1],
+        tensors[2],
+        torch.empty_like(tensors[0]),
+        "layer",
+        prequantized_query=tensors[0],
+        prequantized_key=tensors[1],
+        prequantized_value=tensors[2],
+        prequantized_query_descale=tensors[3],
+        prequantized_key_descale=tensors[4],
+        prequantized_value_descale=tensors[5],
+    )
+
+    assert impl.standard_calls == 0
+    assert impl.prequantized_calls == 1
+    assert impl.received_prequantized_qkv is not None
+    assert all(
+        actual is expected
+        for actual, expected in zip(impl.received_prequantized_qkv, tensors)
+    )
+
+
+def test_unified_attention_custom_op_schema_has_prequantized_qkv():
+    schema = str(torch.ops.vllm.unified_attention_with_output.default._schema)
+
+    for argument in (
+        "prequantized_query",
+        "prequantized_key",
+        "prequantized_value",
+        "prequantized_query_descale",
+        "prequantized_key_descale",
+        "prequantized_value_descale",
+    ):
+        assert f"Tensor? {argument}=None" in schema
+
+
+def test_unified_attention_rejects_unsupported_prequantized_qkv(monkeypatch):
+    impl = _RecordingAttentionImpl(supports_prequantized_qkv_input=False)
+    _patch_attention_context(monkeypatch, impl)
+    tensors = _make_tensors()
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="does not support prequantized QKV"):
+        attention_module.unified_attention_with_output(
+            tensors[0],
+            tensors[1],
+            tensors[2],
+            torch.empty_like(tensors[0]),
+            "layer",
+            prequantized_query=tensors[0],
+            prequantized_key=tensors[1],
+            prequantized_value=tensors[2],
+            prequantized_query_descale=tensors[3],
+            prequantized_key_descale=tensors[4],
+            prequantized_value_descale=tensors[5],
+        )
+
+    assert impl.standard_calls == 0
+    assert impl.prequantized_calls == 0
+
+
+def test_unified_attention_standard_path_is_unchanged(monkeypatch):
+    impl = _RecordingAttentionImpl(supports_prequantized_qkv_input=False)
+    _patch_attention_context(monkeypatch, impl)
+    query, key, value, *_ = _make_tensors()
+
+    attention_module.unified_attention_with_output(
+        query,
+        key,
+        value,
+        torch.empty_like(query),
+        "layer",
+    )
+
+    assert impl.standard_calls == 1
+    assert impl.prequantized_calls == 0

+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers import (
+    fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant as prep_module,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import attention as attention_module
+from vllm.model_executor.models import qwen3_next as qwen3_next_model
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import PrequantizedQKV
+
+NUM_QUERY_HEADS = 8
+NUM_KV_HEADS = 1
+HEAD_DIM = 256
+ROTARY_DIM = 64
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("max_num_seqs", "expected"),
+    [
+        (256, True),
+        (257, False),
+        (None, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_supports_prequantized_scheduler(
+    max_num_seqs,
+    expected,
+):
+    assert prep_module.supports_prequantized_scheduler(max_num_seqs) is expected
+
+
+def test_fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant_is_cudagraph_unsafe():
+    op = torch.ops.vllm.fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant.default
+    assert torch.Tag.cudagraph_unsafe in op.tags
+
+
+def _make_inputs(tokens: int = 8):
+    q_gate = torch.randn(tokens, NUM_QUERY_HEADS * 2 * HEAD_DIM)
+    key = torch.randn(tokens, NUM_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM)
+    value = torch.randn_like(key)
+    query_norm_weight = torch.randn(HEAD_DIM)
+    key_norm_weight = torch.randn(HEAD_DIM)
+    cos_sin_cache = torch.randn(tokens, ROTARY_DIM)
+    positions = torch.arange(tokens)
+    return (
+        q_gate,
+        key,
+        value,
+        query_norm_weight,
+        key_norm_weight,
+        cos_sin_cache,
+        positions,
+    )
+
+
+def _make_outputs(inputs):
+    q_gate, key, value, *_ = inputs
+    tokens = q_gate.shape[0]
+    query = torch.randn(tokens, NUM_QUERY_HEADS * HEAD_DIM)
+    output_key = torch.randn_like(key)
+    gate = torch.randn_like(query)
+    query_fp8 = torch.zeros(
+        tokens,
+        NUM_QUERY_HEADS,
+        HEAD_DIM,
+        dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+        device=q_gate.device,
+    )
+    key_fp8 = torch.zeros(
+        tokens,
+        NUM_KV_HEADS,
+        HEAD_DIM,
+        dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+        device=key.device,
+    )
+    value_fp8 = torch.zeros_like(key_fp8)
+    query_descale = torch.randn(256, NUM_KV_HEADS, device=q_gate.device)
+    key_descale = torch.randn_like(query_descale)
+    value_descale = torch.randn_like(query_descale)
+    return (
+        query,
+        output_key,
+        gate,
+        query_fp8,
+        key_fp8,
+        value_fp8,
+        query_descale,
+        key_descale,
+        value_descale,
+    )
+
+
+def _run_impl(inputs, outputs) -> None:
+    prep_module._fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant_impl(
+        inputs[0],
+        inputs[1],
+        inputs[2],
+        inputs[3],
+        inputs[4],
+        inputs[5],
+        inputs[6],
+        "layer",
+        1.0e-6,
+        NUM_QUERY_HEADS,
+        NUM_KV_HEADS,
+        HEAD_DIM,
+        ROTARY_DIM,
+        *outputs,
+    )
+
+
+def test_fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant_translates_attention_metadata(monkeypatch):
+    inputs = _make_inputs()
+    expected_outputs = _make_outputs(inputs)

+    metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+        num_actual_tokens=7,
+        query_start_loc=query_start_loc,
+        num_decodes=1,
+        num_decode_tokens=1,
+        num_extends=1,
+        num_prefills=0,

+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        attention_module,
+        "get_attention_context",
+        lambda layer_name: (metadata, None, None, None),

+    recorded_kwargs = None
+

Here `*_allocate_prequantized_outputs` returns empty (i.e. uninitialized) tensors, probably to serve as placeholder due to the inflexible interface. It's okay, but these unitialized tensors are packed into a `PrequantizedQKV`, then `self.attn(...)` is called (Vllm's Aiter integration) with it. On the Vllm's Aiter integration side, it uses `q_descale=None` (in the decode branch of `AiterFlashAttentionImpl`'s `_forward()` method at`vllm/v1/attention/backends/rocm_aiter_fa.py`). There is probably a structural reason why the decode path in the integration is not consuming it though. Nonetheless, this is quite bug-prone to have this sort of unenforced contract IMHO.
